claim.quote: With a total exposure of 4.1 kg days, we derived the limits in the a_p-a_n (WIMP-nucleon couplings) plane and excluded a large part of the parameter space allowed by the UKDMC experiment.

name: First results from dark matter search experiment with LiF bolometer at Kamioka Underground Laboratory

summary.plain: Eight small lithium fluoride crystals cooled to near absolute zero in the Kamioka mine set limits on how strongly dark matter couples to protons and neutrons through spin.
summary.technical: 168 g LiF bolometer array, 4.1 kg d (22 November 2001 to 12 January 2002), 2700 m.w.e.: limits in the WIMP-proton / WIMP-neutron coupling plane excluding a large part of the region allowed by UKDMC NaI results; spin-dependent proton cross-section limit improved by about a factor of 5 over the shallow-site pilot run (body of the paper).

title: First results from dark matter search experiment with LiF bolometer at Kamioka Underground Laboratory
why_it_matters: First underground spin-dependent dark matter result with a fluorine bolometer in Japan, complementary to the sodium-iodide results.
